notes: «كنا في جنازة أم أبان» is Ibn Abi Mulayka's own first-person narrative and the matn is cut («وساق الحديث»): whether the chain stops at him or goes on to a Companion needs a ruling (rule 11)
the remark «ولم ينص رفع الحديث عن عمر» names Ayyub and Ibn Jurayj as the fuller line: a variant group, not a route
